'Planning Center holds no other record of her' is a claim about the whole upstream directory; what Tally actually checked is one id (410/404) and one merge trail. The commonest reason a person record is *deleted rather than merged* in Planning Center is an office admin cleaning up a duplicate by hand — and in exactly that case another record of this child is sitting upstream, Tally has not looked for it, and Priya, reading a sentence that tells her a second copy is impossible, presses the one loud button and writes the duplicate. That is the outcome the journey names as the failure mode this codebase is most careful about, and this frame is the only place in the nine that puts a sentence between a leader and it. Planning Center holds no other record of her, so this writes one new person and never a second copy.'
